summary: Recent updates to WebRender, the GPU compositor in Firefox, have focused on improving rendering precision and performance by refining how elements are processed. Key changes include **enhancements to how shadows and borders are rendered**, with better alignment and snapping to device pixels, allowing for sharper visuals. Furthermore, a significant portion of unused code related to the older brush mode has been removed, streamlining the rendering process and potentially increasing speed and efficiency. These improvements not only make web pages look better but also ensure smoother performance during complex graphics tasks, which is crucial for modern web applications and graphics-intensive sites.
